success.title: Debug Mode Disabled
success.details: WordPress debug mode is disabled on your live site, which is the recommended setting.

error.title: Debug Mode Enabled
error.details: WordPress debug mode is enabled, which could expose sensitive information.
steps: Set WP_DEBUG to false in wp-config.php
Use debug mode only in development

learn_more.description: WordPress debug mode is useful for development but can expose sensitive information about your site's configuration and errors to visitors. It should always be disabled on production sites.
